messages:
nightdash-bot: [ALERT] 03:12 UTC nightly-perf-dashboard — 99p latency +14% vs baseline, overall throughput -9% over last 3 hours. Affected cluster: eu-west-1-runner-group.

maya: seeing the same on per-route view. spike starts ~03:03, right after the 03:00 deploy window. :eyes:

jonathan: noticed PR #5123 landed in that window — large rewrite of kernel selector heuristics + opportunistic batching tweaks.

albert: I pulled a quick profile from a repro canary pod. flamegraph sampling looks like kernel switch count doubled during tail events. short snippet:```
kernel_selector_switches  samples
old_selector  110
new_selector  235
kv_evictions_per_min  baseline=12  now=38
```

rachel: kv evictions x3 makes sense with more kernel churn — gets cache thrash -> more upstream loads -> higher p99.

jonathan: queuing a CI perf bisect now, running against the merge window range (commit 9a1f..f3b2). will post job id.

ci-perf-bot: perf-bisect queued — job 4472. metric=99p_latency, delta_target>=5%. first run expected ~10m.

maya: thanks. can we also try disabling the opportunistic batching path from #5123 on a canary? hypothesis: selector oscillation + batching together amplifies tail.

albert: quick local patch to force single-kernel-per-request reduces p99 ~12% in my microbench. throwing a small patch: PR-5137.

jonathan: PR-5137 looks good for a hotfix. opening canary rollout (2 hosts) with it now. holding the main rollout. :hand:

infra-bot: canary deployed PR-5137 to eu-west-1-runner-group-canary (2/2). health checks OK.

maya: after canary flip: 99p latency back to baseline within 7m. throughput restored. early signal looks promising.

ci-perf-bot: bisect job 4472 first candidate results: commit 7f5a -> +8.3% p99, confirmed regression window aligns with merge of PR #5123.

jonathan: looks like the merge is the likely cause. options: revert #5123, merge hotfix PR-5137, or adjust rollout policy to keep this from auto-progressing.

rachel: prefer hotfix + targeted revert if hotfix doesn't fully cover. also update rollout gating so perf alert blocks auto-rollout for 30m post-deploy.

albert: root cause summary: new kernel selector increases kernel switches on mixed-sequence workloads. that increases KV cache churn (evictions) which raises remote fetches and amplifies tail latency. Batching heuristic changes made the effect worse by grouping mixed sequences into same batch more often.

maya: action items: 1) merge PR-5137 hotfix to stop selector oscillation (jonathan) 2) backfill full CI perf bisect across longer history (albert) 3) temporarily revert #5123 if hotfix fails (rachel) 4) add perf hold to release pipeline (maya).

jonathan: I'm merging hotfix now and starting the longer bisect. will keep canary pinned until we have +24h clean.

infra-bot: rollout hold engaged for main rollout. automatic rollback on perf regressions enabled.

maya: will update the nightly incident channel + add a quick note in the release PR. thanks y'all. :thumbsup:

rachel: leaving a short postmortem checklist in the release thread and scheduling a post-deploy retro tomorrow to discuss selector tests.

albert: saved profile and perf artifacts to s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/3695001234/ for deeper analysis.

jonathan: if anyone wants to run a repro load locally, command I used:```
./scripts/loadtest --target=canary --model=rdw-13b --mix=short:70,long:30 --qps=120 --duration=600
```

maya: good signal. will close this thread once main rollout is green for 24h. keep pings here for any surprises.

ci-perf-bot: bisect job 4472 completed — culprit commit: f3b2 (PR #5123). regression magnitude 8.3% p99.

jonathan: filing revert PR #5140 as contingency. will wait 1h for hotfix metrics before reverting.

rachel: tagging oncall SRE to keep an eye on eu-west dashboards overnight. @oncall-sre please monitor.

oncall-sre: acknowledged. I'll monitor for the next 8h and alert if p99 > baseline +5% for >15m.

maya: thanks everyone — great quick triage.
